## User problem

Who is blocked, and what are they trying to do?

## Smallest useful change

Describe the expected outcome and a concrete example. Explain why existing
templates, commands or instructions do not already solve it.

## Acceptance and tradeoffs

How would we verify the improvement? Note compatibility changes, dependencies
or host-specific requirements. Links to relevant primary sources are welcome.
